title: Empty-patch no-op skips closedAt/permission gates
description: Regression from batch 45 (0f48f5cc). The {} no-op exit (Ok(true)) in chat-server runs before the gates: space.rs no-op ~1285 precedes the closedAt check ~1381, so {} to a closed Space returns updated {id:null}, but draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 (054dcb1 ~L911) says the server MUST reject every Space/set update to a closed Space with forbidden, except self-removal. Likewise ban.rs (stored_ban_denied/may_set_space_ban) and emoji.rs (may_set_custom_emoji): a caller without update permission gets success for {} instead of forbidden. Fix: no-op exit after existence + permission/closedAt gates. Also check scene avatar.rs (b8b8436d): strip_read_only_patch now runs before the owner check, so a non-owner gets invalidProperties instead of forbidden; restore owner check first. Same ordering audit for mail/vtc/contacts/calendars no-op exits. Tests: oracle the spec MUST text.
